technical_quality: Adequate PA film, good inspiration, no significant rotation; L side marker present in upper right of image confirming conventional orientation. Slight over-penetration of upper mediastinum.

devices.type: external radiographic side marker (L) with technologist initials
devices.location: upper right corner of image (patient's left upper, outside thorax)

abnormalities.finding: small dense calcific foci at the hilum, consistent with calcified hilar lymph nodes (old granulomatous disease); more conspicuous on the right
mild prominence of basal/perihilar vascular markings without Kerley B lines, peribronchial cuffing, or alveolar opacity; equivocal for interstitial edema

description_zh: 胸部正面 PA 片，吸氣良好，無明顯旋轉。心臟大小正常，縱膈輪廓正常，兩側肋膈角銳利，未見肋膜積液。兩側肺野通氣良好，僅見兩側下肺野及肺門周圍血管紋理輕度增加，未見明確 Kerley B 線、支氣管周圍套袖徵或肺泡性浸潤，肺水腫之影像證據不明確。兩側肺門可見小型鈣化緻密影（右側較明顯），符合舊性肉芽腫性病變之鈣化淋巴結；左橫膈下可見正常胃泡，未見任何管路或引流裝置。
